Every big stop follows the same shape

Each place gets its own scenario. What stays the same is the arc, and the challenge grows the deeper you go.

1ArriveDark, flooded, dead. You breathe from your own craft, parked close by.
2Read the placeThe building, the creatures around it and what was left behind show what broke and what it needs.
3Earn itThat place's own scenario: a hands-on puzzle, a build, a material you work out from clues.
4It comes aliveLights come on room by room, power returns and one room drains.
5SanctuaryStand up, breathe and rest. You wake here from now on. Charging, repairs and fabrication open, and the place's story fills in.

Where air comes from

Power is air: your cockpit and your air line both run on the craft's battery. Service points give power. Only homes, big stops you've earned and the vessels you bring give you a place to stand up and rest. Hover a place for details.

Home: always air Big stop: earned dry room, power, rest and wake Service point: power only

The big stops, getting harder

These are kinds of challenge, not final designs. Each place's scenario gets designed with you; the story stays out of this view.

Breaths along a first playthrough

Rough arrival windows (uncalibrated estimates) against depth. Each blue mark is a place you earn. Orange diamonds are service points you pass between them, and with power they keep you breathing.
